name: Yannis Tsarouchis
bio: Yannis Tsarouchis was a Greek modernist painter and set designer who achieved international fame, and was "known in particular for his homoerotic subjects," including soldiers, sailors, and nude males.

paintings.title: Cafe Neon (Night)
paintings.story: Cafe Neon (Night) (Greek: Καφενείον το Νέον (Νύχτα)) is an oil painting by Yannis Tsarouchis created between 1965 and 1966.
facts: It depicts the facade of the eponymous cafe, which exists today in Omonia Square in Athens.

The theme of "coffee shops" has occupied Tsarouhis repeatedly within the overall interest to study the contemporary urban landscape, not only in space but also as a social context and version of an overall lifestyle.
